0x0008F0.en: 「With what I've got now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x0009E9.en: 「Damn it!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x000C13.en: 「Tch! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000C4E.en: 「Like hell I'll blow it here...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000CA2.en: 「Blew it...!@　Nothing to do but pull out...」

0x000DF3.en: 「So this is it... the rest is on you.」

0x000E61.en: 「Nngh! So they got the jump on me...」

0x000E9F.en: 「No good, we took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000EEC.en: 「Well, this is a mess. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000F2A.en: 「Kyah, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000F71.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x00101C.en: 「Ngh... So I become a shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x0010D3.en: 「Owowow... I give up. Guess I miscalculated.」

0x001158.en: 「Ngh...! Is this as far as I go...!」

0x0011C5.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x00120C.en: 「I'm sorry. The rest is up to you.」

0x001241.en: 「Dammit! Is this the limit of my strength...!」

0x00132D.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ How green I am...!」

0x00137B.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001465.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0014D2.en: 「I can't go on. Please excuse me.」

0x00155D.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll withdraw for now...!」

0x001781.en: 「Kh...! Not in a place like this!!」

0x001A6F.en: 「...The Steel Dragon Squadron raided Bunker 8@ and seized the NV Unit.」

0x001AE4.en: 「Hmph... To think they'd strike first.@ Decentralizing weapons development backfired...」

0x001B67.en: 「For them to make such a decision as things stand...」

0x001BAA.en: 「They may have had some backing.@ I can guess roughly from whom.」

0x001C00.en: 「Also, Dr. Eric Wong has been@ confirmed missing.@ He may have been taken by the Steel Dragon Squadron...」

0x001CB4.en: 「If he went with them of his own will,@ then he may be the one who leaked@ the NV Unit's data to outsiders.」

0x001D4A.en: 「A man I could never quite read... but no matter.@ If the Steel Dragon Squadron fields it, we can use them@ to draw out the Ruina.」

0x001DF8.en: 「Sir...@ There are also reports that three Melior Esse@ units appeared at Bunker 8.」

0x001E7F.en: 「Drew them in already.@ And... did the Steel Dragon Squadron repel the Ruina?」

0x001EEA.en: 「Yes. Afterward they shook off our pursuit@ and vanished. But we have a rough idea@ of where their current base lies.」

0x001FB3.en: 「I see.@ Now then, which Saber shall we send...」

0x001FFD.en: 「Duvan and Dr. Tomine have@ requested a sortie several times.」

0x002059.en: 「Dr. Tomine I understand... but why Duvan?」

0x0020A2.en: 「He wants an Einst core.@ Since Red Ogre made contact with the Steel Dragon Squadron,@ he thinks he may find a lead through them.」

0x002171.en: 「Ah... Amara reported as much.@ So he means to escape his fate?」

0x0021EE.en: 「He shouldn't even know that himself, but...」

0x00222B.en: 「If his real target is Red Ogre,@ his focus may drift. Delta might be better.」

0x0022A5.en: 「But they made the grave blunder of losing Jinrai,@ and mass-production units alone won't...」

0x002322.en: 「No matter. Sending in cannon fodder has its uses.」

0x002406.en: 「I'm grateful for the chance to redeem myself.」

0x00244C.en: 「Meaning to take back Jinrai?@ By now they may be refitting it@ to add to their own forces.」

0x0024DC.en: 「That's possible, but...@ it won't be so easy for them.」

0x002532.en: 「Hmph... Unreliable.@ I'll take it to the Commander directly.」

0x0025D3.en: 「Lord Alteur is busy.@ He has no time to indulge your selfishness.」

0x002638.en: 「Selfishness...?@ Hardly. It's a sound proposal, surer than Delta.」

0x002694.en: 「You just can't find Red Ogre and you're impatient, no?@ Or do you still pine for Ariel?」

0x002736.en: 「I'm ordering you to stand down.@ Omega is the highest Saber... with command@ authority over Alpha and below. I told you, didn't I?」

0x0027DB.en: 「Hmph... And I hear that Omega was outdone@ by the reborn ill-omened bird. Along with Egretta.」

0x00286B.en: 「Once my Ares gains an Einst core,@ it can defeat any machine the Steel Dragon Squadron has.」

0x0028F1.en: (Hmph. Even if he fulfills his wish,@ whether his fate will change...)

0x00295D.en: 「...Why did AI1 show a rejection response?@ Razmnanium also stirred abnormally, it seems.」

0x0029F0.en: 「We've just removed AI1 from Medius@ and are investigating now.」

0x002A52.en: 「If the cause is that it absorbed@ the TE Absorber parts and@ the Terminus Engine, that's a grave problem.」

0x002AEB.en: 「As I said before,@ MODEL-X will carry a pilot@ and my adjusted AI0. That's decided.」

0x002B93.en: 「Commander Alteur has approved it as well.」

0x002BC7.en: 「...With AI0, we can't get the most out of@ Razmnanium's performance.」

0x002C3B.en: 「True, its self-repair will drop, but@ MODEL-X has combat power@ more than enough to make up for it.」

0x002CDD.en: 「Even without AI1, it'll be the strongest TE Absorber.@ It isn't the interactive type anyway,@ so it's hard for a pilot to handle.」

0x002DA0.en: 「I've no desire for a noisy child, after all.」

0x002DE6.en: 「That view of yours is rather warped.」

0x002E88.en: 「Units 8 and 9 will run tests on AI0@ until suitable pilots are found.@ That's out of consideration for your position and past service.」

0x002F5B.en: 「Also, for MODEL-X's pilot,@ I'm considering Duvan Org.」

0x002FCF.en: 「With Dr. Ozunu dead,@ Project Idealants has hit a wall,@ and Alles Geist has many problems too.」

0x00307D.en: 「He seems quite attached to the Ares, though...」

0x0030C3.en: 「We aren't scrapping it.@ And once he learns MODEL-X's power,@ he'll take interest.」

0x003153.en: (...At this rate, my child will...@ I have to do something...)

0x0031A9.en: 「...That's all, then.@ Return to your investigation and adjustment of AI1.」

0x003215.en: (Back then, AI1 seemed to hesitate@ to fight her...)

0x003277.en: (No way...@ No, that can't be...@ I scanned and checked it afterward.)

0x0032F5.en: (AI1, what did you feel...?@ Was it, too, for the sake of further evolution...?)

0x003401.en: 「Hah, hah... 300 sit-ups, done!@ Looks like the training's really paying off.」

0x0034A0.en: 「Thanks, Irui.@ ...Sorry for making you keep me company.」

0x0034FC.en: 「It's fine...@ But why train so hard like this?」

0x00355E.en: 「Well... just because.@ Anyway, it's about time. Let's head to the hangar.」

0x00360F.en: 「The exterior work is nearly done.@ All that's left is the final tuning of System LIOH.」

0x00368C.en: 「So it's finally complete...@ Painting the machine white was the right call after all.@ I think it's shed the Jinrai image.」

0x00372B.en: 「That said, we're reusing its torn RAM mantle.」

0x00378D.en: 「It looks cool, like a scarf.@ So, can it move already?」

0x0037F5.en: 「Yeah. We'll run the startup test@ as soon as Major Sanger returns. He's the one@ most used to the Double G and DML System combo...」

0x0038C1.en: 「We'll have him help gather the initial data.」

0x0038FE.en: 「I see...@ By the way, Minaki. Have you decided@ this guy's new name yet?」

0x003992.en: 「I've got an idea. How about Raijin?」

0x0039D5.en: 「...That's just Jinrai@ flipped around, isn't it?」

0x003A41.en: 「Needs a bit more of a twist, don't you think?」

0x003A66.en: 「It means Jinrai, once our enemy, is now our ally...@ Also, it now uses a plasma converter for attacks, so...」

0x003B44.en: 「Even so, the name is a bit confusing.」

0x003B75.en: 「Um... Actually, I was thinking up a new name@　for this thing too...」

0x003BFF.en: 「Right. It runs on System LIOH, so... Raiou...@　The kanji for 'thunder' and the 'ou' from@　phoenix. 'Raiou.'」

0x003D00.en: 「Um... there's no twist to it at all, though.」

0x003D37.en: 「Touma, the 'ou' in phoenix means the female bird...」

0x003DD3.en: 「Then it's 'hou'... which makes it Raihou.@ Well, we'll just read that part as Raiou anyway.」

0x003E81.en: 「Then it's settled. From today, this thing@　isn't Jinrai, it's Raihou.」

0x003F37.en: （And the Steel Dragon Squadron still hasn't@　made it back yet...!）

0x003F84.en: 「Could they have found out about this base...?」

0x0040AC.en: 「No, nothing so far. Maybe this is a dud too?」

0x0040E9.en: 「Hmph... If we could just use the <ＭＡＰＷ>@　from the start, this would be so much easier.」

0x00413E.en: 「Yeah, no kidding. Why do they make us drop@　those first?」

0x004187.en: 「Delta Saber's been racking up failures.@　They want a big win here, I'd wager.」

0x0041F8.en: 「And I've got no interest in getting stuck@　drawing the short straw on their account.」

0x004251.en: 「Then hurry up and drop the cargo. No matter@　how we treat them, they never complain -@　that's their one redeeming trait.」

0x0042DE.en: 「Try and draw a winner, at least.@　...We're withdrawing from this airspace.」

0x004340.en: 「Mass-Produced Jinrai descending from Target@　Alpha! Count: 9!」

0x004393.en: 「Mass-Produced Jinrai descending from Target@　Alpha! Count: 12!」

0x0043EC.en: 「What a nuisance... and right over the@　camouflaged runway...!」

0x004438.en: 「At this rate, the base's existence@　could be discovered...!」

0x00448B.en: 「I hope we can somehow ride this out...」

0x0044BF.en: 「The enemy group is attacking the surface!@　Th-the runway lift mechanism is exposed!」

0x004521.en: 「Ngh! We have no choice - launch interceptors!@　How much longer until the Steel Dragon Squadron returns!?」

0x0045D5.en: 「We have to hold out until then, no matter what...」

0x00488B.en: （True, to respond immediately in this situation...）

0x00589B.en: （Can I do this...? No, this is no time@　to hesitate!）

0x0058E8.en: （I've made up my mind...! To do what I've@　always wanted to do! So...!）

0x005954.en: 「Let's do it, Raihou!@　I'm staking everything I've got on you!!」

0x005C32.en: 「Th-that part's... okay, I think.@　I managed to fight the mass-production ones.」

0x005EA0.en: 「A man who overestimates his power in his@　first battle dies! Leave the rest to us@　and fall back!」

0x005F36.en: 「All right...@　Eleve 1 to all units! Destroy those Jinrai!」

0x006017.en: （Minaki... this thing will become the power@　you wished for...）

0x00606A.en: （And I'll fight to protect the Earth's@　peace... fight... uuu... uu...）

0x00610A.en: 「It was his first battle - no wonder@　he's worn out, huh?」

0x006CB5.en: 「Minaki...@　did you know System LIOH had a function@　like that?」

0x006E31.en: 「System LIOH scans the pilot's physical ability@　and traits, and after selecting a Basic Battle@　Style, it optimizes itself...」

0x00702B.en: 「So System LIOH seems to have adjusted itself for@　close-quarters combat using its built-in weapons...@　for hand-to-hand fighting...」
